shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && rg --files | head -200 && cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && cat app/layout.tsx && cat app/page.tsx && cat 'app/products/[slug]/page.tsx'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat lib/products.ts && cat tsconfig.json && rg -n \"cacheComponents|use cache|cacheLife|cacheTag|Suspense|connection|dynamic|revalidate|fetch\" . --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' && git status --short && find __agent_eval__ -maxdepth 2 -type f -print"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/products/'[slug]'/page.tsx lib/products.ts next.config.ts tsconfig.json && git status --short && rg -n 'dynamic\\s*=|dynamicParams\\s*=|revalidate\\s*=|fetchCache\\s*=' app lib next.config.ts || true"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore && git diff -- package.json next-env.d.ts && git ls-files package-lock.json .next && git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal | head -80 && ls -la .next | head'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json next-env.d.ts .gitignore && rg -n 'dynamic\\s*=|dynamicParams\\s*=|revalidate\\s*=|fetchCache\\s*=' app lib next.config.ts || true"
